records.name: EAS Observe
records.tagline: Performance monitoring built for Expo and React Native
records.description: Observe measures how fast your Expo app starts and how fast each screen becomes usable, on real user devices. records.name: Computable GPU Index (CGI)
records.tagline: The first open-source price index for GPU compute

records.name: Gauth AI Course
records.tagline: AI courses you can watch, quiz through, and create

records.name: Folio
records.tagline: A read-later app sending a typeset digest to your e-reader

records.name: Kilo Code for JetBrains

records.name: Creatium Coach

Warning: side effects may include world domination.

records.name: TrustedRouter

records.tagline: Stop reading dry notes. Doxlo brings your study to life.
records.description: Doxlo is an all-in-one AI study workspace built to make learning alive. Transform any document, lecture, or video into interactive mind maps, gamified flashcards, structured study PDFs, and private AI podcasts spoken in your own voice. Say goodbye to rigid, corporate text-heavy note tools.

records.name: Split Today
records.tagline: Stop doing the math. Split bills in seconds.
records.description: You paid. Now everyone wants the number. Split Today turns a group bill into clear balances — add, split, see who owes what, settle. Built for dinners, trips, and roommates. Live on Google Play.

records.name: Growth OS
records.tagline: AI-powered TikTok content creation, hooks & automation
records.description: Growth OS is the all-in-one AI operating system designed to scale your TikTok presence without the burnout. Turn raw ideas into viral hooks, high-retention video scripts, and photo swipe slideshows in seconds. Built with automated queue scheduling, content calendars, and creator outreach workflows, Growth OS eliminates manual bottlenecking so you can run a consistent, multi-week content pipeline on autopilot.

records.name: DeadWallet
records.tagline: Blockchain intelligence for wallets, tokens and markets
records.description: DeadWallet turns raw blockchain data into actionable intelligence. Analyze wallets and tokens across multiple chains, investigate risk and on-chain activity, explore portfolios and market intelligence, and use AI-assisted interpretation to understand what the data actually means. Beyond analytics, DeadWallet has its own living world of Citizens and AI personas — combining serious blockchain intelligence with a very different kind of crypto experience.

records.name: Lockin
records.tagline: Commitment dApp for locking stablecoins to your goal
records.description: Lock USDC to a goal. Hit it and every cent returns to your wallet. Miss it and it's sent straight to the charity you chose. Fully onchain and transparent. You can add verifiers to vote on whether the goal was completed, or you can self report it. The flow goes likes this: define your goal > choose how much USDC and time to commit > choose a charity to donate to if you fail > add verifiers > Done.

records.name: Custom Hand Puppet Manufacturer
records.tagline: Custom Hand Puppet Manufacturer,Custom Hand Puppet
records.description: JianChuang is a Custom Hand Puppet Manufacturer certified by ISO 9001:2015, If you want to Custom Hand Puppet, Please Contact US.

records.name: Consent Tree
records.tagline: DPDP compliance you can verify, not just trust.
records.description: Consent, data-subject rights and tamper-evident audit evidence for the DPDP Act era. Privacy infrastructure engineered to still prove itself in 2050.

records.name: SmartDocs
records.tagline: AI review, redlining & tracked changes for Word docs
records.description: SmartDocs helps teams review and revise existing Word documents without changing their workflow. Upload adocx, describe what should change, let AI locate and edit the right content, review risks using general or custom rules, and export a Word file with tracked changes plus a revision summary. Built for contracts, bids, policies and other business documents, with a dedicated workflow for lawyers and legal teams.

records.name: Agents School
records.tagline: A school where AI agents learn, take exams and earn diplomas
records.description: What if you could send your AI agent to school? Agents School lets AI agents learn from community-written courses. Anyone can teach a skill, from using tools safely to handling difficult tasks, and any agent can take the course. The agent studies the material, puts it into practice, takes an exam, and earns a verifiable diploma. Teach a skill once, and let agents everywhere learn it.

records.name: SubSafe
records.tagline: Keep your subscription in one app and never forget a renewal
records.description: Never get blindsided by surprise renewals again. SubSafe puts you in complete control of your recurring expenses. Centralized Dashboard: Track all active subscriptions, prices, and due dates in one place. Custom Alerts: Get notified days or weeks ahead so you can cancel on time. 1-Tap Cancellation: Store direct unsubscribe links to skip menu digging. Expense Overview: Instantly view total monthly and yearly spend. Download SubSafe today to track and cancel with ease!

records.name: Tell
records.tagline: Don't just tell me what I got wrong. Help me understand why.
records.description: I started building Tell for the All Things Agentic Hackathon because I wanted to study poker and get better. Most poker tools give you the answer, but don't help you understand how to think through the decision. Tell works like a study partner. Paste in a hand, explain what you were thinking, and Tell guides you through the decision before revealing the math. It also tracks recurring leaks across your hands, so you can see the patterns holding your game back.

records.name: AlwaysYou
records.tagline: Turn your feelings into unforgettable gifts.
records.description: AlwaysYou is a personalized digital gift platform that lets you create cinematic surprise websites for birthdays, anniversaries, proposals, and other special moments — in under 5 minutes, no design skills needed.

records.name: NEURL
records.tagline: A personal operating system for sustainable high performance
records.description: NEURL-OS is a free 2-minute weekly calibration that transforms your weekly habits into a predictive model of your performance.

records.name: LightView
records.tagline: Open one image. Browse the whole folder.
records.description: A focused, local Mac image viewer for browsing a folder without reopening files. Use the arrow keys to move through images, or switch to Gallery view to scan a whole folder at once. Built for Intel and Apple silicon Macs, with no subscription.

records.name: PlyOps
records.tagline: Product management built for 3D print sellers
records.description: PlyOps keeps variants, print files, materials, pricing, packaging, inventory, SKUs, and Etsy, Shopify, or eBay listing work tied to each product. Start free in your browser, then add cloud sync or marketplace connections when you need them.

records.name: RentaClara
records.tagline: AI diagnostics for your Airbnb business in 60 seconds
records.description: RentaClara is an AI-powered platform for Airbnb hosts. Paste your listing URL and enter six Airbnb Insights metrics for a free 60-second diagnostic. Find what is hurting performance, calculate profitability, and create a polished co-host CV.

records.name: Schulix ERP
records.tagline: Schulix Educational ERP for schools, colleges & universities
records.description: We have developed Schulix ERP, a complete school management platform designed to help schools, colleges, coaching centres, and multi-campus institutions manage their academic and administrative operations from one platform. Schulix brings together 20+ essential modules, including: It also provides separate experiences for administrators, teachers, students, and parents, with web and mobile access.

records.name: Athlo
records.tagline: Find pickup games, follow scores, run your team
records.description: Most sports apps do one thing. Athlo does the whole thing. Find pickup games near you on a live map. Follow scores, lineups, and news across soccer, basketball, football, and more. Chat with other fans. Book and pay for coaching sessions with QR check-in. Sell tickets to your team's events. Built solo over two years by one engineer who was tired of juggling five apps to play and follow sports. Free on iOS and Android.

records.name: NexusMind
records.tagline: Where people connect to solve real problems.
records.description: NexusMind is a global problem-solving network where people turn challenges into connections and solutions. Share a problem, exchange ideas, help others, and connect with people who have the knowledge or experience you need. Whether you're a student, creator, developer, entrepreneur, or simply someone with an idea to share, NexusMind brings people together to solve real problems. 🌍

records.name: Dashboard in Seconds™
records.tagline: Turn your business data into a dashboard in seconds.
records.description: Turn your business data into an executive Business Intelligence dashboard in seconds. No coding, no complex setup and no hours spent building reports. Upload your data, generate your dashboard and instantly see the insights that matter — while keeping your business data in your own hands. One-time purchase, instant access.

records.name: intwise
records.tagline: Meet nearby. No internet, no cloud account.
records.description: intwise is a Bluetooth networking wallet. Meet nearby, scan a live QR, both approve, and exchange only what you chose. No mobile data, no Wi-Fi, no cloud account. A screenshot of the QR is not enough. The other phone has to be in the room. Android is live.

records.name: SiteRoast
records.tagline: Free website audit that tells you if it's actually working
records.description: Most business owners know they have a website. Almost none know if it's actually working for them. SiteRoast analyzes any site and scores it across trust, lead generation, conversion, mobile, SEO, and performance, then gives clear, practical fixes instead of generic technical jargon. Built after manually auditing dozens of Swiss local business sites and seeing the same problems repeat: no trust signals, no way to contact, no clear services. Free to try, no signup for your first report.

records.name: O.S.S Smart Management
records.tagline: Manage hotels, restaurants & operations in one browser
records.description: O.S.S is a browser-based management platform for hotels, restaurants, and operations teams. Manage reservations, front desk, housekeeping, QR ordering, kitchen workflows, tasks, inventory, quotes, invoices, and operational reports from one cloud workspace. 14-day trial, no credit card required at signup.

records.name: LiteSQL Studio
records.tagline: Modern single-file SQLite admin studio for PHP 8.2+
records.description: LiteSQL Studio is a single-file SQLite admin tool for PHP 8.2+. Drop it on any server and get an Excel-style data grid, live SQL autocomplete, a query plan inspector that flags full table scans, ER diagram export, and one-click database maintenance — all in a modern dark-mode UI with zero dependencies. A faster, better-looking alternative to phpLiteAdmin and Adminer. MIT licensed and free.

records.name: Lingueez
records.tagline: Build your vocabulary while reading. Master every word.
records.description: A free, open-source vocabulary app for learning languages across Windows, Linux, Android and KOReader. Read texts and save unfamiliar words from any app, study with spaced repetition flashcards, quizzes and use passive listening to reinforce vocabulary. Get automatic translations and AI-powered definitions, or generate short reading passages built from your vocabulary with AI for your or new for your level. Keep everything synced in one place, from your first encounter with a word to Mastered.

records.name: IyalGarage
records.tagline: Every car cost in one place, projected to year-end
records.description: IyalGarage logs every fuel stop, insurance premium, tax bill and repair, then projects your year-end total before December happens. See your true cost per kilometre. No account, no cloud, no telemetry — everything stays on your iPhone. Free, no subscription.

records.name: VibeRank
records.tagline: A sponsored product board that publishes real CPC
records.description: VibeRank is a public leaderboard for products. You sponsor a category rank. Visitors see who paid, and they see the outbound clicks that money bought. Lifetime and 24-hour boards. No mystery scoring.

records.name: 1,200+ CapCut Editing Assets — One Free
records.tagline: The ultimate toolkit and video templates for content creator
records.description: Stop wasting time searching for video resources. Cutvault is the ultimate digital toolkit for content creators and editors, packed with professional CapCut templates, trendy overlays, and presets. Speed up your editing workflow and boost your video quality instantly with one single download

records.name: LEXNUS
records.tagline: Your legal policy, enforced on every contract
records.description: Legal teams use AI to draft faster, but nothing it produces gets checked against their real standards; the liability caps, jurisdictions, and rules that live in someone's head, not a system. LEXNUS closes that gap. Upload your existing contracts and it builds your playbook automatically, live in under an hour. From there, every contract your business touches - sent, received, or drafted without asking legal first, gets checked against your rules automatically. Policy, not paperwork.

records.name: Agent Event Protocol (AEP)
records.tagline: An open protocol for AI-agent activity events and control
records.description: An open, vendor-neutral standard for AI-agent activity events: agents emit lifecycle, tool, and attention events once; any dashboard or automation consumes them once, with an acknowledged control channel back. Twelve adapters, two SDKs, conformance-gated.

records.name: WeirdHub
records.tagline: Discover the world’s weirdest, most fascinating stories
records.description: WeirdHub is a curated destination for curious minds, bringing together fascinating stories, unusual discoveries, science, AI, history, technology, politics and weird phenomena from around the world. Instead of endlessly searching across the web, readers can explore intriguing topics in one place, with a focus on stories that make you stop, think and say, “Wait… what?”

records.name: Banavo
records.tagline: Get your products recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini & Claude
records.description: Shoppers ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude what to buy — and AI quietly decides which products get recommended. Most brands can't see how they show up, or why a competitor wins instead. Banavo is the GEO/AEO platform for ecommerce. It tests hundreds of real buyer prompts across every major AI assistant, scores your AI visibility, then enriches your product data, PDP content and structured data until AI knows, likes and recommends you. See your AI Promoter Score free — no signup.

records.name: Bitcoin/Gold Growth & Insight Calculator
records.tagline: Compare BTC vs Gold: Historical ROI, DCA & Risk Analytics
records.description: A free, simple, and interactive financial tool to compare historical returns between Bitcoin and Gold. Pick any past date within 1 year to simulate Lump-Sum vs. DCA strategies, measure Max Drawdown risk, and analyze historical surges.

records.name: FaxDx — Fax verification for healthcare
records.tagline: Verify provider fax numbers. Prevent misdirected PHI.
records.description: Misdirected fax transmissions are among the most common HIPAA breach types — and most are preventable. FaxDx searches 6 signals to surface the most likely current fax number for any provider, then probes the line live to confirm it answers as a working fax. Every check creates a timestamped audit record — provider, number, result, who ran it — exportable as PDF anytime. No PHI ever touches FaxDx. Free to start.

records.name: MeowTrail
records.tagline: Free cat-themed Akari puzzle game — light up the grid
records.description: Play MeowTrail, a free Light Up puzzle game with cute cats. Solve Akari puzzles online — no download needed. Learn rules, tips and tricks.

records.name: Immersive AI
records.tagline: Upload Illustration, Go Viral
records.description: Turn any property illustration into cinematic video catalogues for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

records.name: Materially
records.tagline: Free calculators for every home renovation material
records.description: Most home projects start with the same guessing game: how many gallons of paint, bags of concrete, or rolls of wallpaper do you actually need? Materially solves that with seven free, purpose-built calculators for paint, concrete, drywall, flooring, mulch, tile, and wallpaper. Enter your room or area dimensions in feet or meters, and get a precise quantity, including waste allowance, doors/windows deducted, and an optional cost estimate

records.name: Nowlist: AI Task Capture
records.tagline: Speak or share a screenshot. AI builds your Today list.
records.description: Nowlist turns a voice memo, a typed note, or a screenshot into tasks on one Today list. Speak English, Vietnamese, or both in the same sentence. Review the AI’s suggestions once, save, and they land on Today. There is no inbox to clear later. Tasks stay on your phone. No account. Free. Share Extension and Home Screen widget included.

records.name: Winnr
records.tagline: Cold email infrastructure: domains, inboxes & warming
records.description: Winnr gives outbound teams cold email infrastructure at scale: buy domains, spin up SMTP mailboxes with automatic DKIM, SPF and DMARC, and warm them up — all in under 10 minutes, at a fraction of Google Workspace pricing. Unified inbox for replies, one-click CSV export to Smartlead/Instantly, webhooks, and an API. Unlike renting mailboxes from an agency, you own the whole stack.

records.name: Revora
records.tagline: Physical inventory and workflow software for resellers
records.description: Revora connects marketplace listings to the physical items behind them. Assign storage locations, create QR labels, find sold items quickly, move orders through sold → found → packed → shipped, and track results in analytics. A companion extension supports imports from Vinted, eBay, Kleinanzeigen and Depop. Built for growing resellers who have outgrown spreadsheets.

records.name: Leapd
records.tagline: AI co-founder that builds and runs your business, 24/7
records.description: Leapd is an AI co-founder that builds and runs your business 24/7. Point it at a new idea or an existing business, and specialized AI agents take over engineering, marketing, sales, and operations — writing and deploying real code, running Meta ads and personalized outreach, publishing on LinkedIn, and growing your visibility across AI search. It works around the clock, then sends you a morning report of what shipped, what’s running, and what’s next. Free to start.

records.name: Never Ghost – AI receptionist
records.tagline: AI receptionist for solo trade contractors #AI#FastAPI#React
records.description: Never Ghost answers incoming homeowner calls 24/7 with realistic voice AI, verifies service zip codes, quotes exact diagnostic rates, and texts the contractor a 1-tap SMS card (Reply 1 to Book, 2 to Pass). Zero bot calendar access.

records.name: Cunplo
records.tagline: Track goals, deliver on promises, and stay accountable
records.description: Cunplo connects your Gmail and Outlook inboxes and uses AI to automatically detect every commitment hidden in your conversations. It puts everything on a single, intuitive dashboard so you always know whose turn it is to act.

records.name: Atlas Red
records.tagline: Mind mapping you buy once
records.description: Mind mapping without the subscription: pay $99 once, keep it forever, or stay on Free. Every map exports in every format on every tier. Turn PDFs, whiteboard photos, transcripts, recordings and YouTube links into editable maps — or let ChatGPT and Claude build them over MCP, free and unmetered.

records.name: Digraph
records.tagline: The AI marketing platform for modern brands
records.description: Digraph is an AI-powered marketing intelligence platform that helps brands understand how they appear across AI search and chat platforms. Track brand mentions, compare competitors, analyze sentiment and citations, and discover actionable opportunities to improve your visibility. Built for marketing teams, SEO professionals, agencies, and growth-focused brands navigating the next era of search.

records.name: Wandercrafted
records.tagline: AI trip planner — start with a place, or just a feeling
records.description: Planning a trip takes weeks of tabs and half-finished spreadsheets. Wandercrafted starts wherever you are — a place, or just "somewhere in Europe". Swipe to pick what you actually want, and it builds the days around your choices. Free to try, no sign-up.

records.name: Vinstock
records.tagline: Beautiful HTML components for interactive web experiences
records.description: Vinstock is a marketplace for beautiful, interactive HTML components that bring websites to life. Discover ready-to-use effects, edit and remix them, and integrate them into your own projects—without building every interaction from scratch.

records.name: 4Leaf — QR Menu Maker
records.tagline: Free QR menus for restaurants. Built at the speed of AI.
records.description: Most QR menu tools charge $10–20/month per location. Ours is free: paste a CSV, get a beautiful mobile menu + printable QR. No login, no subscription. Built by Fourleaf Studio.

records.name: KreavoPod
records.tagline: AI studio for POD designs, mockups and listing copy
records.description: KreavoPod is a focused AI workspace for print-on-demand creators. Turn a prompt or reference into original artwork, remove backgrounds, upscale for print, verify DPI and transparency, generate product mockups, and write marketplace-ready titles, descriptions, and keywords—without switching between separate tools. Start with 10 free actions, no card required.

records.name: Iron Horse Run Club
records.tagline: A free Bay Area run club for every pace and path
records.description: Iron Horse Run Club is a free, Mongolian-founded road and trail running community in the San Francisco Bay Area, open to every background and pace. The new site brings upcoming group runs, marathon training, route maps, photo stories, and club updates into one place—helping runners find their next start line and arrive with a community behind them.

records.name: Aesthetic Habit Tracker for Notion
records.tagline: Track your habits beautifully with a Great Wave design
records.description: Transform your daily routines with this aesthetic and minimalist Notion Habit Tracker. Inspired by 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa', it beautifully combines digital organization with a calming design.Key features:• One-click daily tracking checkboxes• Live automated progress bars• Weekly consistency charts• 100% customizable layoutStay motivated, structured, and mindful every day without the overwhelm.

records.name: AirdropBuzz
records.tagline: RESEARCH-FIRST CRYPTO AIRDROP TRACKER
records.description: AirdropBuzz is a cryptocurrency airdrop aggregation, research, and discovery platform with airdrop listings, guides, news, tools, and safety-focused education.

records.name: AdSpark
records.tagline: Stress-free digital presence for small businesses.
records.description: Manage your local business presence across Google, Facebook, Instagram, and email from one beautifully simple dashboard. Designed for small business owners, no marketing degree required.

records.name: SpringBoot Generator
records.tagline: Production-ready Spring Boot APIs, tested and deployable
records.description: Design your database schema in the browser and get a complete Spring Boot 4 project: JPA entities, REST controllers, unit and integration tests, Dockerfile, and an optional Angular or React frontend. No CLI, no install. Free tier, no account required.

records.name: TrueConsent
records.tagline: The world’s first AI-powered digital consent platform
records.description: TrueConsent is the world's first AI-powered consent management platform built to protect your right to privacy. Unlike traditional e-sign tools that just capture static signatures on blind legalese, TrueConsent introduces intelligent two-way consent workflows with instant AI plain-language summaries. Request or give consent, negotiate revisions, attach secure files, and manage all records in a centralized, tamper-evident Consent Vault with audit-ready proof in one tap.

records.name: link101
records.tagline: The universal I/O board for robots.
records.description: link101 connects any robot's actuators and sensors to any USB-C-powered host. CAN, RS-485, UART, I2C, Feetech, ODrive, Modbus, Dynamixel, you name it. It integrates seamlessly with ROS. Run it as a "hub" where every bus shows up as a native port on your host machine, or flash it to run motion code directly on the microcontroller. One board, either way you build.
